newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stock market stagnant as buyers stay away.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stock market stagnant as buyers stay away.

text.p: Croatian stock market was almost stagnant an hour before close on Wednesday as investors, foreigners in particular sensed the end of a recent bull run, traders said.
"If it goes on, there may be pressure to sell and then prices will fall further," said one broker with a large market share.
Although trade usually intensifies an hour before close at 2 p.m. (1300 GMT), very few transactions were made by none and some on negligible volume.
"People aren't even picking Zagrebacka Banka offers at 1,800 kuna, that tells you a lot," the trader added.
Fully-listed Zagrebacka ordinary stock closed at 1,890 kuna on Tuesday, up 54 kuna from last Friday.
But the morning saw a steady decline to $30.62 from $31.87 of its 1/10 GDRs on Seaq International in London.
The trader mentioned hotel issues Riviera, Laguna and Istraturist, and Podravka and Kras food stocks as among those few that still attracted moderate investor interest.
A drop to $16.12 from Tuesday's $16.47 of drugs firm Pliva GDRs also did not bode well for the Croatian market, analysts said.
